paragraphs: I'm applying for the Sr. Financial Analyst, Revenue FP&A role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role sits at the center of Olo's board reporting for Thoma Bravo, and I like that it covers the full cycle, from the numbers through to the finished slides.

At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and reconciliation work where we reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At Lenovo I built forecasts, models and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I worked on dashboards that cut reporting time by 4+ hours a week.

Running the monthly revenue cycle, explaining what moved in the forecast and taking manual work out of reporting all build on that background. I'm comfortable building models in Excel and would be glad to learn Pigment as you move onto it. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
